faq.supportAvailable: Our support team is available 24/7 — average response time under 2 minutes.

payoutTime.a: We offer industry-leading ~12 hour payout processing for qualified traders. Once requested, simulated profit withdrawals are typically approved and dispatched within 12 hours.

timeLimit.q: Are there any time limits on challenges?
timeLimit.a: No! CK Capital has zero time limits on challenge evaluations. Trade at your own pace without pressure to hit arbitrary deadlines.

platforms.a: CK Capital supports both MetaTrader 5 (MT5) and TradeLocker with advanced charting, real-time market data, and fast execution.

profitSplit.q: What profit splits do you offer?
profitSplit.a: CK Capital offers up to 100% profit splits for verified traders on funded accounts. You keep up to 100% of your trading profits.

drawdown.a: Our risk parameters are transparent: 4% maximum daily drawdown and 8% maximum overall drawdown based on starting balance.

newsTrading.q: Can I trade news and hold over weekends?
newsTrading.a: Yes! News trading is fully permitted across all accounts, and you can hold positions overnight and over weekends.

consistency.a: We promote sustainable risk management and consistent trading habits across all challenge phases.

cryptoFunding.q: Do you accept crypto payments and payouts?
cryptoFunding.a: Yes, we support major cryptocurrencies and bank transfers for both evaluation purchases and reward distributions.

refundPolicy.a: Yes, challenge fees are refunded with your first eligible reward payout upon qualifying as a CK Trader.

expertAdvisors.q: Are Expert Advisors (EAs) and bots allowed?
expertAdvisors.a: Yes, algorithmic trading, EAs, and indicators are welcome as long as they follow standard risk guidelines.

instantPayouts.q: How quickly can I start trading with Instant Funding?
instantPayouts.a: You can be trading within minutes of purchase. Instant Funding accounts are activated immediately.

tradingObjectives.glossaryHeadingTitle: Know the rules before you trade.

glossary.title: Profit Target
glossary.desc: The simulated profit objective that must be reached during an evaluation phase before the account can progress to review.

glossary.title: Maximum Daily Loss
glossary.desc: The maximum permitted loss during a trading day. Your dashboard should clearly display your current daily-loss usage and remaining allowance.

glossary.title: Maximum Loss
glossary.desc: The maximum total permitted loss on the account. Reaching or exceeding the defined maximum-loss level may result in an account breach.

glossary.title: Minimum Trading Days
glossary.desc: The minimum number of qualifying trading days required before completing an evaluation stage.

glossary.title: Consistency
glossary.desc: Certain CK Capital models may include a consistency requirement designed to encourage sustainable and disciplined simulated trading behaviour. Always check the requirements associated with your selected evaluation.

tradingObjectives.unlimitedDesc: CK Capital evaluation programmes currently provide unlimited trading periods, allowing you to focus on following the objectives rather than racing against an expiry date.
